department: School of Natural and Environmental Sciences

deadline.value: Research applications are accepted throughout the year on a rolling basis, while funded studentships have fixed project-specific deadlines.
deadline.quote: The majority of studentships have a fixed project title and named supervisor or supervisors.

entry_route.value: Academic entry requirements are specified in individual course profiles and studentship adverts, typically requiring a 2:1 honours degree or a master's qualification.
entry_route.quote: Academic and English language requirements are all given in individual course profiles. Studentship adverts will specify academic and English language requirements.

supervisor.value: Postgraduate researchers engage in independent research under the guidance of experienced academic supervisors.
supervisor.quote: As a postgraduate research student at Newcastle, you’ll engage in independent research under the guidance of experienced supervisors, and with the support of our Doctoral College. Y

funding.value: Postgraduate research funding is competitive via university studentships, Doctoral Training Centres and Partnerships, and external research councils.
funding.quote: We invest in research funding to support our postgraduate research students. There are many options and opportunities for you to explore.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Postgraduate research programme (Biological Sciences PhD) in the School of Natural and Environmental Sciences at Newcastle University.
